rationale: The previous iteration's candidate showed excellent performance with zero line loss events and low steering oscillation on both the oval and s-bend tracks, confirming the effectiveness of the geometry and sensor layout. The controller tuning with kp=4 and kd=6 provided good damping and stability. The evaluator suggested further tuning if oscillations or line loss events arise, including reducing kp to 3.5, increasing ki to 0.7, and increasing base_speed to 1.7 if completion time does not improve. Since the candidate has not yet raced, I will cautiously reduce kp from 4 to 3.5 to further reduce any potential oscillations, increase ki from 0.5 to 0.7 to improve integral action and help correct steady-state errors, and increase base_speed from 1.6 to 1.7 to attempt to improve completion time without sacrificing stability. The line_loss strategy remains 'search_left' as it was effective previously. The geometry and sensor weights remain unchanged as they have proven successful. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations further, maintain zero line loss events, and improve completion time. I request measurements including completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to verify these hypotheses in the next race.
